task: What phone number is shown on this page?

texts.text: DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA. Every value below is fabricated. No real person, account or document is represented.

Ground truth for the evaluation harness is carried in data-gt="CATEGORY" attributes.
        Detectors are forbidden from reading them — see the data-gt guard test.
        The face section below uses a separate data-face-gt attribute instead of data-gt on purpose: the Stage 2 DOM-only baseline eval
        ( e2e/baseline.spec.ts ) scans every [data-gt] element and scores
        it against that eval's own DOM-only detectors, which have no notion of faces at all — a data-gt="FACE" would count as a guaranteed false negative there and corrupt
        an unrelated, already-measured report.
